tools.name: list_players
tools.description: List every store, platform, payment network, and protocol on the Agent Shopping Tracker, with status and the page to credit.

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Look up one tracker row by slug, such as walmart or etsy. Credit the Page URL in the result. Keep the note. It is uncertainty.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search dated news. Filter with since (YYYY-MM-DD), a player slug, or words from the title, summary, or tags. Credit each item's Page URL.

tools.name: get_blocklist
tools.description: Summarize which retailers' public robots.txt files name AI agents, and where to read the full check. robots.txt is a request, not proof of a block. Credit the blocklist page.

tools.name: which_retailers_block_agents
tools.description: List retailers whose public robots.txt disallows an AI agent token, fully or partly. Pass a token such as GPTBot or ChatGPT-User, or omit it for any tracked agent. Credit the blocklist page. A disallow is not proof the site enforces it.
